grain_rationale: row_count is 44721 and duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, so no exact duplicate rows exist in the source; invoice_id alone is not unique (distinct_count 2330 versus 44721 rows) because an invoice spans many product lines, so a derived identity over invoice_id, stock_code, and invoiced_at is used to uniquely key each invoice line event; the zero duplicate rate confirms this composite tuple is not needed to absorb duplicate rows, only to express the natural multi-column key of a line.

fields.name: invoice_id
fields.description: Identifies the parent invoice (e.g. 489434, 489435) with null_rate 0.0 but distinct_count 2330 versus 44721 rows, confirming many lines share one invoice.

fields.name: is_cancellation
fields.description: Flags whether the line represents a cancellation, with exactly two distinct values (false, true) and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: stock_code
fields.description: Product/stock code such as 10002 or 10123C, with distinct_count 3141 and null_rate 0.0, labeling which item the line refers to.

fields.name: product_description
fields.description: Free-text description of the product (e.g. '12 PENCILS SMALL TUBE POSY'); nullable with null_rate 0.005098, likely missing for a small set of unlabeled or discontinued stock codes.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Units billed on the line, ranging from -1395 to 5184 with null_rate 0.0; negative values correspond to return or cancellation lines and are summed/compared across rows.

fields.name: invoiced_at
fields.description: Timestamp the line was invoiced, ranging from 2009-12-01T07:45:00 to 2009-12-23T16:58:00 with null_rate 0.0; sample values vary by minute with seconds always at :00, so minute is the finest resolvable grain.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Price per unit ranging from 0.0 to 1998.49 with null_rate 0.0, a monetary amount compared and aggregated across lines.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Numeric customer identifier ranging from 12346 to 18287 that labels rather than measures; nullable with null_rate 0.300664, meaning roughly 30% of lines lack customer attribution.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country of the invoice (e.g. Australia, Austria, Belgium) with 24 distinct values and null_rate 0.0.

category_description: One row represents a single product line on a customer invoice, capturing the stock item, quantity, unit price, and timestamp at which that line was billed or cancelled.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver_invoice_lines table enters the gold unified event star as the invoice_lines fact category, so the deterministic modeling engine can generate the corresponding gold fact and dimension models from it.
usage: The proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, linted with datacontract lint, and reviewed and approved by a human before the modeling engine consumes the contract to emit gold models; the mapping itself never executes.
limitations: The mapping does not filter or reclassify cancellation lines (is_cancellation has 2 distinct values) nor interpret negative quantity values (ranging to -1395), leaving return/cancellation handling to downstream consumers; customer_id is null for roughly 30% of rows (null_rate 0.300664), so customer-level rollups must account for unattributed lines, and product_description gaps (null_rate 0.005098) are left unresolved.
